answer_1.quote: In Section 5, we describe our attempt to incorporate the principles from the theory of linguistic puzzle design into LLM prompts for the purpose of generating new puzzles.
answer_1.outputs: preamble, context, questions, solutions, and explanations for linguistic puzzles

answer_4.quote: To design our evaluation framework, we relied on the expertise of three accomplished Linguistic Olympiad participants.
answer_4.guideline: We asked our evaluators to attempt solving these five Rosetta Stone-type puzzles using a fill-in-the-blank (FITB) format. In addition, we asked our evaluators to indicate their confidence in the correctness of their solutions, estimate the difficulty level of each puzzle, and describe the features that made a puzzle easier or harder to solve.
